thread:
Asha Verma: FYI we got a pilot request from PolyglotLabs: they need Optimize toolkit recommendations for batching, caching, and quantization for a multilingual long-context pipeline. Key asks: per-language quant profiles, runtime fallback rules, and eval-triggered alerts scoped to prompt-sets. They want a runnable pilot plan next week.
Liam O'Connor: Sounds doable. Do we already support language-aware routing predicates?
Priya Rao: Not today. We have model/tier/route predicates. Adding language as a first-class predicate is a small extension but needs schema + unit tests.
Maya Chen: Important: long-context requests mean language detection must be done on the initial chunk to avoid scanning full context. That could add ~2-4ms CPU; include perf as acceptance criteria.
Asha Verma: Proposed pilot scope: 1) ingest 1k-2k customer prompts per language, 2) run baseline vs 4-bit/8-bit quant evals, 3) produce recommended quant profile per language with confidence score, 4) implement policy to route to fp16 when confidence below threshold, 5) wire eval-triggered soft alerts to #support + dashboard.
Liam O'Connor: Policy DSL sketch: `match: language IN (fr,zh,ar); condition: quant.confidence < 0.80; action: route->fp16`. We'll need to add a rollout flag and kill-switch.
Priya Rao: Ops asks: canary rollout plan (0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%), SLI checks per-lang, and an alert suppression window (10m) to avoid flapping.
Maya Chen: Acceptance metrics suggestion: per-language quality delta <= 2% (customer metric), p99 latency increase <= +40ms, language-detect overhead < 5% CPU on p95.
Asha Verma: Owners: Priya -> policy DSL & tests, Liam -> eval harness + report, Maya -> perf bench & runbook. I'll coordinate with PolyglotLabs for prompt samples and preferred scoring.
ops-bot: Created tasks: #4521 evals (Liam), #4522 policy-dsl (Priya), #4523 perf+runbook (Maya), #4524 customer sync (Asha). ETA next-week pilot artifacts.
Liam O'Connor: For eval-triggered alerts, recommend soft alerts first (slack/email), escalate to PD after 3 consecutive failing batches in 24h. Also expose a dashboard tile showing per-lang routing fraction and active quant profile.
Priya Rao: I'll add schema changes and a migration plan. Keep policy change behind a feature flag for easy rollback.
Asha Verma: Great. I'll ask customer for anonymized prompt sets and confirm quality metric today. If they share, Liam can start eval runs immediately. Thanks all.
